name: Favicon Generator (ICO, PNG Set, Manifest)

seo.title: Favicon Generator (ICO, PNG Set, Manifest) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Generate a favicon.ico, common PNG favicon sizes and a web-app manifest snippet from one square source image.

assumptions: ICO entries use PNG-compressed icon images for modern browser compatibility.
limitations: A favicon set cannot guarantee visual clarity at tiny sizes; inspect 16×16 and 32×32 previews.
